lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular 2D grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with approximately 5 to 7 spots visible per column in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs to create a series of anchor nodes forming a rectilinear pattern across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature is visible running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a high-intensity luminance edge on its superior aspect and a lower-intensity shadow gradient on its inferior aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Visible high-luminance blobs are distributed within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, showing a lower spatial density compared to the adjacent lateral flank area.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits displays a high-density cluster of smaller high-luminance points that are significantly more concentrated than the pattern observed on the posterior flank.
